title: Critter Crop
instructions:
Grow a garden and critters will visit and move in. Click or tap to use the tool in your hotbar: 1-9 pick a tool, 0 opens the backpack.
At night, drag a critter back and let go to fling it at Sludge Critters. Double-click or double-tap a critter for details. Arrow keys or WASD move the view, P pauses.
